name: The Prisoner
source:
At first I thought she was my friend. A beautiful, mysterious friend, just for me...
I kept her a secret, kept her safe behind glass. And she rewarded me.
But when I wanted her to leave, I realized how perilous she was.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29905]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
起初我以为她是我的朋友。一个美丽而神秘的朋友，只为我而来……
我为她保守秘密，让她安全地躲在玻璃后面。她奖励了我。
但当我想让她离开时，我才意识到她有多危险。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29905]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
